description.en: Control a KNX installation through a KNX/IP gateway. Enter the gateway IP and import your entities (paste ETS CSV or Home Assistant KNX YAML, or point to an ETS .knxproj); the integration auto-builds native lights, switches, covers, climate, sensors, and scene selects.

value.en: On the next screen, enter your KNX/IP gateway IP address and paste your ETS 'Group Addresses' CSV export. The integration builds all entities automatically.
